decisions.reason: The glazed industrial sectional door fits the firm's established industrial door business, and it stayed on the website through 2019; without evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, there is no trigger for problemistic search, and the large firm's slack lets it carry the product.

The insulated glazed variant serves rising demand for energy-efficient industrial buildings and remained listed in 2019, so its results likely meet aspirations and dropping it would release few resources.
The firm gave this product a dedicated page in both years, which signals continued commitment and satisfactory performance, so management has no reason to withdraw it.
